title: ABC Composition Structured Output
description: Schema for structured ABC notation output used by the composition agent and drum specialist agent. The assembler (assembleAbcNotation) converts this object into valid ABC notation text.

referenceNumber.description: ABC reference number (e.g., 1). Emitted as X:1

defaultNoteLength.description: Default note length (e.g., '1/8', '1/4', '1/16'). Emitted as L:{defaultNoteLength}

key.description: Key signature (e.g., 'C', 'Dm', 'G major', 'Amin'). Emitted as K:{key}

midiExtensions.description: Global MIDI extensions emitted after headers, before voice declarations. Each entry becomes a %%MIDI or %% directive line.

oneOf.description: Set MIDI instrument program for a channel. Emitted as: %%MIDI program [channel] {program}

channel.description: MIDI channel 1-16. If omitted, uses current melody channel.

oneOf.description: Inline repeating drum pattern. Emitted as: %%MIDI drum {pattern} {programs...} {velocities...}

pattern.description: Drum hit/rest pattern. ONLY characters d (hit) and z (rest), no spaces or numbers. Example: 'dzdzdzdz' (4 hits).

programs.description: GM drum numbers (35-81), exactly one per 'd' character in pattern.

velocities.description: Hit velocities (0-127), exactly one per 'd' character in pattern.

oneOf.description: Guitar chord accompaniment instrument. Emitted as: %%MIDI gchord {instrument}

instrument.description: GM program 0-127 for chord accompaniment voice.

oneOf.description: Map an ABC note letter to a GM percussion sound on channel 10. Emitted as: %%MIDI drummap {note} {midiPitch}

note.description: ABC note letter to map (e.g., C, D, E, F, G, A, B, c, d, e, f, g, a, b).

midiPitch.description: GM percussion MIDI number (35-81) to assign to this note letter.

oneOf.description: Enable inline drum pattern playback. Emitted as: %%MIDI drumon
Disable inline drum pattern playback. Emitted as: %%MIDI drumoff
Select MIDI channel for melody voice. Emitted as: %%MIDI channel {channel}

directive.description: Full directive line without %% prefix. Families: PNEUMA (humanize/heartbeat/drift/free/rubato), ENSEMBLE (offset/jitter), BREATH (auto/bars/after/off), GRAVITY (phrase/weight/agogic/off), DYNAMICS (curve/transition/attack/off), SPECTRAL (tilt/cc/off), SPATIAL (group/delay), TRANSFORM (source/retrograde/invert/invertaxis/fragment/pitchshift/timescale/delay/off), SHADOW (source/mode/probability/transpose/delay/invertmotion/intervallock/off). Examples: 'DYNAMICS curve exponential', 'ENSEMBLE jitter 5', 'BREATH auto 15', 'GRAVITY phrase 8', 'GRAVITY weight 1.15 1.0 0.95 0.85', 'SPATIAL group A voices 1,2', 'SPATIAL delay A B 10'.

voices.description: Musical voices/parts. At least 1 required. Each becomes a [V:{id}] section in the ABC output.

id.description: Voice ID (e.g., '1', 'melody', 'bass', 'drums'). Emitted in voice header as [V:{id}].

name.description: Human-readable voice name. Emitted in voice header as [V:{id} {name}].

clef.description: Musical clef. 'perc' auto-assigns MIDI channel 10. Emitted as clef={clef} in voice header.

midiProgram.description: GM instrument 0-127. Emitted as %%MIDI program {midiProgram} after voice header. Do NOT set on perc voices.

forkDirectives.description: Per-voice abc2midi-llm fork directives without %% prefix. Each emitted as %%{directive} after voice header. Examples: ['PNEUMA humanize 10', 'ENSEMBLE voice -5', 'ARTICULATE auto', 'SPECTRAL cc 74 0.5', 'TRANSFORM source 1', 'SHADOW source 1'].

notes.description: ABC note content. Either a single string with | bar separators, or an array where each element is one measure (joined with | during assembly).
